integrity: Exact mathematical argument and reproducible finite cross-checks are provided. The verification script corroborates finite examples, and does not replace the unrestricted proof. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The all-size theorem concerns one complete permutation sweep of asynchronous binary Rule 60 on a periodic ring. It does not concern synchronous updates, repeated-site schedules, or nonlinear rules. A plausible 2015 paper on distinct intermediate-boundary Rule-60 characteristic matrices was available only at the abstract level; complete historical priority has not been independently verified.
title: Exact companion-polynomial classification of sequential Rule-60 dynamics on rings
